title: claude.ai Gmail connector keeps returning "session expired" after user reconnects via /mcp
details:
- **What happened:** Every mcp__claude_ai_Gmail__* call (search_threads, create_draft) returned `MCP server "claude.ai Gmail" session expired`. That included calls after the user reported the connector as reconnected and after the tool schemas were reloaded with ToolSearch. Expected: calls succeed after the reconnect.
- **What the user said:** "gmail ist wieder verbunden" (after I asked them to reconnect with /mcp); earlier "wieszo nicht via mcp?"
- **Repro:** In a long session, call a claude.ai Gmail tool and get "session expired". The user reconnects through /mcp, ToolSearch select reloads the Gmail tools, the same call fails with the same error.
- **Evidence:** 2026-10-29, macOS, 5 failed calls in total (2 before the reconnect, 3 after it, counting the one after the ToolSearch reload).
